name: Kufri Fun World
description: A popular amusement park offering thrilling rides and a scenic view of the snow-capped mountains, perfect for families and adventure seekers.

name: Mahasu Peak
description: The highest peak in Kufri offering panoramic views of the Himalayas and a serene environment for trekking enthusiasts.

name: Himalayan Nature Park
description: A wildlife sanctuary showcasing Himalayan flora and fauna, including rare species like the Himalayan monal and musk deer.

name: Fagu Valley
description: A tranquil valley known for its apple orchards and scenic beauty, ideal for a peaceful walk and photography.

name: Kufri Mini Zoo
description: A small zoo featuring local Himalayan animals, offering an educational experience for children and nature lovers.

name: Skiing Slopes Kufri
description: Famous for winter sports, these slopes offer skiing and snowboarding experiences for beginners and experts alike.

name: Indira Tourist Park
description: A beautifully maintained park with lush greenery and walking trails, perfect for a quick nature break.

name: Gurudwara Shri Guru Singh Sabha Kufri
description: A peaceful Sikh temple known for its spiritual ambiance and beautiful architecture.

name: Chini Bungalow
description: A historic colonial-era bungalow showcasing traditional architecture and offering a glimpse into Kufri's past.

name: Kufri Yak Ride
description: Experience a unique yak ride through the scenic trails of Kufri, a fun activity for all ages.

name: Mahasu Temple
description: An ancient temple dedicated to Lord Mahasu, set amidst serene surroundings offering spiritual solace.

name: Kufri Sunset Point
description: A hidden gem spot perfect for watching breathtaking sunsets over the Himalayan ranges.

name: Apple Orchard Walk
description: Stroll through lush apple orchards and learn about local apple farming traditions from friendly farmers.

name: Kufri Horse Riding
description: Enjoy a scenic horse ride through the hills and valleys of Kufri, suitable for beginners and children.

name: Kufri Ice Skating Rink
description: A seasonal ice skating rink offering fun and excitement for visitors during the winter months.

name: Kufri Market
description: A bustling local market where you can shop for handicrafts, woolens, and taste local Himachali cuisine.

name: Tobogganing Track Kufri
description: A thrilling tobogganing track offering an exhilarating ride down the snowy slopes for all age groups.

name: Kufri Bird Watching Spot
description: A lesser-known spot ideal for bird watchers to spot Himalayan birds in their natural habitat.

name: Kufri Ropeway
description: A scenic ropeway ride offering stunning aerial views of Kufri and the surrounding Himalayan landscape.

name: Local Himachali Cuisine Experience
description: Savor authentic Himachali dishes at local eateries, offering a rich taste of the region's culinary heritage.
